name: ClawLink
description: Connect 1,000+ apps (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Google Calendar, Notion and others) to OpenClaw via ClawLink. One skill, 39,000+ tools, managed OAuth. Use when the user asks to act in an app they connected through ClawLink (for example send a Gmail email, create a GitHub issue or post in Slack), or asks to use ClawLink. Not for local files or for tools outside ClawLink.
author: ClawLink <hello@claw-link.dev>

apiKey.label: ClawLink local credential
apiKey.help: Managed automatically by browser pairing. You usually should not edit this manually. Stored locally in OpenClaw's plugin config; never sent to the assistant.
